title: When Every Choice Is Correct: A Causal Study of Numerical Preference in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model chooses a number between 1 and 30, every integer in the range is valid, yet the model can favor particular answers. We use numerical choice to study how preference is processed across layers and tokens. Perturbation probing and gradient attribution nominate neurons for activation interventions. In a selected Qwen3-4B case, a pre-answer edit changes 17 to 15 while both runs first emit 1. After the edit ends, selective cache and attention-output replacements trace part of its continuing influence on the second digit. Replacing one attention head's output or the other heads' outputs jointly produces similar immediate readout contributions; both interventions restore 17 but have different final log-odds effects on 7 versus 5. Holding later multilayer perceptron (MLP) outputs at their values from the edited run without either replacement reduces this effect gap from 0.119 to 0.0025 nat. Later computation therefore change

translated_title: 当每个选择都正确时：语言模型中数值偏好的因果研究
translated_abstract: 当语言模型在1到30之间选择一个数字时，该范围内的每个整数都是有效的，然而模型可能会偏爱特定的答案。我们利用数值选择来研究偏好是如何在不同层和不同词元之间被处理的。扰动探测和梯度归因方法确定了用于激活干预的候选神经元。在一个选定的Qwen3-4B案例中，答案生成前的编辑使输出从17变为15，而两次运行都首先输出1。在编辑结束后，选择性缓存和注意力输出替换追踪到了该编辑对第二位数字的部分持续影响。替换单个注意力头的输出或联合替换其他注意力头的输出会产生相似的即时读出贡献；两种干预都能恢复出17，但对7与5之间的最终对数几率产生不同的影响。在没有任何替换的情况下，将后续多层感知机（MLP）的输出保持为编辑运行时的值，可将这种效应差距从0.119 nat缩小到0.0025 nat。因此，后续计算改变……
tldr: 该研究以数值选择任务为载体，通过激活干预等因果分析手段追踪语言模型中数值偏好的形成过程，发现后续MLP层的计算在很大程度上决定了编辑对生成数字（如第二位数字）的持续影响。
en_tdlr: Using numerical choice as a testbed and causal activation interventions, this study traces how numerical preference is processed across layers and tokens in language models, showing that later MLP computation largely determines an edit's persistent influence on the generated digit.
